verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Backlinks section grouped at the bottom of each object, block-level linking and references, and a graph view of connected notes. That covers linking and backlink visibility, and community users describe connecting notes into a network of thoughts. Missing for 10: explicit [[wiki-style]] link syntax, unlinked-mention detection, backlinks shown with surrounding context, and independent hands-on corroboration of backlink behavior.
